findings.evidence: Both proofs use `refine Algebra.finrank_eq_of_equiv_equiv (ResidueField.mapEquiv e…) …; obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := residue_surjective x; simp only [RingHom.coe_comp, …, ResidueField.map_residue]; refine congrArg (residue …) (Subtype.ext ?_); rw [… RingEquiv.coe_subringCongr_apply]`.
findings.fix: Factor out one lemma saying the residue-field finrank (or `relativeDegree`) is unchanged when the valuation subrings below and above are equal, compatibly with algebraMap, and derive both theorems from it.
findings.issue: `relativeDegree_completionPlace` repeats almost word for word the residue-degree transport argument of `relativeDegree_restrictConstants` (Extension/Basic.lean:719): the same `RingEquiv.subringCongr`, `ResidueField.mapEquiv`, `Algebra.finrank_eq_of_equiv_equiv`, `residue_surjective`, long `simp only` and `rw` chain.

findings.evidence: Completion.lean:119-140 and Semilocal.lean:897-907 both build `Q₀` by hand and then do `rw [← P.completionExtensionAlgebra_restrictConstants P' hP]; simp only [Q₀, …completionEmbedding_restrictConstants…]`.
findings.fix: Add a lemma relating `Algebra.trace P.Completion P'.Completion (z * P'.completionEmbedding x)` to the trace of the `Q₀` component in `semilocalEquiv k F' P` (e.g. a `restrictConstants` form of `trace_semilocalEquiv_symm_single_mul`) and use it in both places.
findings.issue: The same step appears twice without a lemma: switch from `P'` to `Q₀ := ⟨P'.restrictConstants k, (restrict_restrictConstants k F P').trans hP⟩`, rewrite with `completionExtensionAlgebra_restrictConstants`, then `simp only [Q₀, completionEmbedding_restrictConstants, …]` to read a single fiber component. It is here and in `sum_trace_mul_smul_completionEmbedding_eq` (Semilocal.lean:897), which makes `completionEmbedding_mem_traceDual_completionIntegers` long and hard to follow.

findings.evidence: Proof term: `⟨fun _ _ _ ↦ by simp only [Algebra.smul_def, map_mul]; exact mul_assoc _ _ _⟩`. After the `simp only`, the two sides agree only up to unfolding the coercion of `algebraMap (𝒪 K) 𝒪_v`.
findings.fix: Use `IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq` with an explicit rewrite (e.g. `algebraMap_adicCompletionIntegers_apply`/`ValuationSubring.algebraMap_apply`) instead of relying on defeq through `exact mul_assoc`.
findings.issue: `isScalarTower_ringOfIntegers_adicCompletionIntegers` is proved by `simp only [Algebra.smul_def, map_mul]; exact mul_assoc _ _ _`. This only closes because the composite algebraMap `𝒪 K → 𝒪_v → K_v` is definitionally equal to the coercion, and no comment says so.

findings.evidence: Semilocal.lean `semilocalHom`: `rw [UniformSpace.Completion.algebraMap_def, WithVal.algebraMap_right_apply, ← Q.1.completionEmbedding_apply, …]` appears twice. Basic.lean:84 has the same chain.
findings.fix: State a lemma `algebraMap F Q.Completion x = Q.completionEmbedding (algebraMap F F' x)` for places of `F'` with the `F`-action from `WithVal.uniformContinuousConstSMul_of_isScalarTower`, and use it in both proof obligations inside the definition.
findings.issue: The `semilocalHom` definition embeds a 5-step `rw` chain (`UniformSpace.Completion.algebraMap_def, WithVal.algebraMap_right_apply, ← completionEmbedding_apply, …`) for `IsScalarTower F P.Completion Q.1.Completion`, plus a second copy of the chain in `commutes'`. The same chain is already used in `algebraMap_completion_eq_completionEmbedding` (Basic.lean:82).

findings.evidence: Last two lines of the proof: `exact Submodule.span_le (p := …) |>.mpr (fun _ hy ↦ IntermediateField.subset_adjoin …) (Submodule.span_mono hsub (htop ▸ Submodule.mem_top))`.
findings.fix: Show `Submodule.span _ (Set.range P'.completionEmbedding) = ⊤` from `htop` and `hsub` with `top_unique`/`Submodule.span_mono`, then apply a span-to-adjoin lemma (e.g. via `IntermediateField.adjoin` containing `Algebra.adjoin` containing the span), with no `▸`.
findings.issue: `adjoin_range_completionEmbedding_eq_top` ends with a hard-to-read term proof: `Submodule.span_le (p := (…).toSubalgebra.toSubmodule) |>.mpr … (Submodule.span_mono hsub (htop ▸ Submodule.mem_top))`. The `▸` rewrite on `htop` depends on elaboration order and breaks easily.

findings.evidence: Second bullet of the final `refine` in the theorem.
findings.fix: Replace with `exact exists_mem_differentIdeal_ord_eq k F P'` (or a `simpa` if the coercion form differs).
findings.issue: `differentIdeal_completionIntegers_eq_pow` has a redundant step: `obtain ⟨y, hy, hy0, hord⟩ := exists_mem_differentIdeal_ord_eq k F P'; exact ⟨y, hy, hy0, hord⟩` takes the existential apart and rebuilds it unchanged.

summary: Proofs are mostly structured, but two non-trivial arguments are duplicated instead of factored, one new instance relies on undocumented definitional equality, and a few proofs carry brittle or redundant steps.
